title: casting to a TV and transcoding

clauses.text: From the Shares page a shared video is sent to a player on the network and controls work on it.

steps.do: Turn the media server on (Shares, m). Press p (Find players), then g (Play on player...) and choose the TV and a shared video.
steps.expect: The TV is listed and shows the video, and plays it with picture and sound.

clauses.text: A file the TV cannot play is converted on the fly and then plays.

steps.do: With the ffmpeg add-on installed, cast a video in a format the TV does not play with g (Play on player...).
steps.expect: The TV plays the video with picture and sound even though the file is in a format it does not play.
